Independent retailers around the globe collectively represent a multi-hundred-billion-dollar wholesale market that has historically been fragmented and offline. At Faire, we're using the power of tech, data, and machine learning to connect this thriving community of entrepreneurs across the globe. Picture your favorite boutique in town - we help them discover the best products from around the world to sell in their stores. With the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive.

We’re looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. If you believe in community, come join ours.

Fulfilled by Faire (FbF) is how brands hand off the hardest part of selling wholesale: picking, packing, shipping, and the cash tied up in inventory. It’s a 0-to-1 build that touches nearly every function at Faire. As Warehouse General Manager, you’ll own the performance of the facility behind it, so orders ship on time, arrive undamaged, and inventory is accurate. • Build the operational team and capabilities the program needs, including key hires and training programs.

• Manage vendors like staffing agencies, carriers, equipment vendors, and other third-party partners to contract terms, performance targets, and accountability.

• Partner to improve systems and tools , working closely with Ops, Product, Engineering, Finance, and Support on the systems and tooling to improve operations in the warehouse.

Qualifications

Experience eCommerce, B2B, wholesale, or 3PL fulfillment with high SKU variety, case-pack and each-pick workflows, and brand-owned inventory.

What you'll be doing

As our Senior Financial Accountant, you'll ensure the integrity of our financial records and drive excellence across our accounting operations.

Here's what that looks like in practice:

- General Ledger and Subledger Ownership - Take full responsibility for General Ledger accounting, ensuring accurate and timely postings, robust documentation standards, and full reconciliation of subledgers. Oversee accounts payable and receivable ledgers, ensuring proper clearing of suspense accounts and accurate reconciliation of bank movements.

- Balance Sheet Integrity - Prepare and review detailed balance sheet reconciliations, ensuring traceability and consistency across accounts.

- Fixed assets and Capex accounting - Manage capitalization policies, amortization schedules, and related accounting treatments.

- Payroll Accounting - Oversee payroll accounting entries in coordination with external providers, ensuring accurate accruals, reconciliations, and consistency with statutory records.

- Audit and Compliance Support - Act as key contact for statutory auditors and provide structured, high-quality supporting documentation.

- Tax and Regulatory Support - Prepare accounting data required for VAT and other tax filings, ensuring consistency with accounting records.

- Continuous Improvement - Identify and implement improvements to enhance efficiency, control, and documentation within the accounting function.

Who we're looking for

This role needs someone detail-oriented, accountable, and equipped with strong accounting expertise to ensure financial accuracy and operational excellence.

- Experience - At least 5 years of experience in accounting within fintech, finance or corporate services, with strong exposure to full closing cycles.

- Accounting Knowledge - Solid knowledge of local accounting principles (Italian and/or Luxembourg GAAP). IFRS exposure is considered a plus.

- Proactive Mindset - Ability to work effectively in dynamic and fast-paced environments, meeting tight deadlines with precision.

- Ownership, Accountability and Team Contribution - Ability to independently manage complex accounting topics and take full responsibility for assigned entities, while actively contributing to the overall quality, consistency, and performance of the Accounting team.

- Technical Skills - Comfortable working in structured ERP environments and modern digital accounting ecosystems. Strong analytical skills and advanced spreadsheet proficiency are required. Experience with automation, data tools, or scripting-based workflows is a plus. Knowledge of SAP S/4HANA is a strong plus.

- Languages - Fluent in Italian and English, ensuring effective communication with international teams.
